The following is a listing of monthly single issues of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. [[VIZ Media]] released these A4 size issues prior to their release of the [[List of Magical Pokémon Journey volumes|collected volumes]] of Magical Pokémon Journey. These monthly issues included some bonus content that was not included in the regular volumes, such as fan art, fan letters, and fold-out posters.

While these were not available in Japan or {{pmin|Singapore}}, these monthly single issues were released in other countries worldwide, including {{pmin|Italy}} and {{pmin|Latin America}}.
